name: Band
description: Band is a group communication app that helps teams, clubs, and communities stay connected and organized. It offers features like group messaging, event scheduling, and file sharing to enhance collaboration and streamline communication.

events.d: Create a new group post with content and optionally send a push notification.
Delete a comment from a post in a Band group.
List posts from a selected band.
Retrieve comments for a specific post, with optional sorting and pagination.
Add a comment to a Band post.
Delete a post from a band using the band and post identifiers.
